cards.title: Keyword vetting with the BID formula
cards.summary: Screen candidate keywords through business potential, SERP intent match and ranking difficulty before committing content budget.
cards.use_when: Product selection and content planning: deciding which keyword clusters to build category, product or comparison pages around for an online store.
steps: Gather candidate keywords from seed terms plus modifiers using a keyword tool's matching-terms report, filtered with include/exclude operators.

Apply B for business potential: ask whether ranking first actually helps the store. A high-volume informational term like 'what is espresso' rarely leads to a purchase, while 'best espresso machine under $500' shows intent and budget.

Apply I for intent: search the keyword and inspect what currently ranks. If the top results are product/category pages and you plan a blog post, the SERP says the searcher wants to buy — match the format or drop the keyword.
Apply D for difficulty: check referring domains and domain rating of the top-ranking pages. Seeing a few low-DR sites in the top 10 is a positive signal per the source.
Only target keywords that pass all three tests.
caveats: BID is the presenter's heuristic, not a scored formula; treat thresholds like 'a few low-DR sites' as qualitative.
AI overviews appear on roughly 21% of keywords overall, and the source cites nearly 58% for question queries, 46% for 7+ word queries, 99.9% informational — verify current figures in your own market.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: AI filter: avoid keywords AI already fully answers
cards.summary: Before targeting a keyword, judge whether an AI overview satisfies the searcher so completely that no click will happen.
cards.use_when: Content prioritisation for a store blog or buying guide where you would otherwise invest in informational posts that never earn clicks.
steps: Take any keyword that passed business-potential and intent checks, then search it and read the AI overview as a shopper would.

Ask whether the AI answer is sufficient or whether the searcher still needs to click for detail, pricing, or options. If the overview nails it, the source says targeting it traditionally may be a trap.
For keywords AI fully answers, do not chase the organic click. Instead re-target them for AEO: aim to have your brand named inside the AI response (see the mention-gap workflow card).

Redirect click-driven effort to action-oriented queries that AI cannot complete — searches containing calculator, checker, generator, tool, template, finder, planner, maker — and to transactional-intent filtered queries, where the source says the organic click is still available.
Verify the current AI overview landscape per keyword in your own market before committing, since coverage changes.
caveats: The claim that AI cannot satisfy interactive tool queries is time-sensitive; re-check as AI interfaces add tool use.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Find competitor mention gaps with branded-query filters
cards.summary: Use AI visibility tooling to isolate prompts where competitors are named but your brand is absent, especially best/top/versus/review/alternative queries.
cards.use_when: Competitive positioning and merchandising decisions about which comparison and best-of content to produce so your store gets named in AI answers.
steps: Enter your domain in an AI visibility tool (the source uses Ahrefs Brand Radar) and open the platform view for the engine you care about.
Use the filter that shows responses mentioning others only — i.e. where competitors appear and you do not.
Layer keyword filters for best, top, versus, review, and alternative to surface the queries where AI recommends brands in your category without you.
Treat the resulting list as your short list of target queries, then plan content and third-party mentions that map to each.
Repeat the report regularly: the source notes over 45% of citations change when AI overviews refresh, roughly every two days.
caveats: Tool menu names may change — verify the current interface before building a workflow.
Brand Radar is the source's commercial product; the underlying method (filtering for competitor-only mentions) is what matters.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Content structure: BLUF, atomic sections, entities, declarative sentences
cards.summary: Four writing rules that let both skimming humans and chunking LLMs extract your key answer from any section of a PDP-supporting article or guide.
cards.use_when: Writing or editing buying guides, category explainers and comparison articles on a store's content hub.
steps: BLUF (bottom line up front): open every section with the answer, not the backstory. Example from the source: 'The most effective way to build backlinks in 2026 is to create original research' instead of several sentences about how the landscape evolved.

Make sections atomic: each H2 should make complete sense if extracted alone, because AI systems chunk pages differently and you cannot control where the split lands. Test by reading an H2 in isolation; rewrite if it depends on earlier context.

Write entity-rich: name brands, products and concepts instead of vague references. 'This tool helps with SEO' becomes 'Ahrefs Keywords Explorer helps you find low-difficulty, high-traffic-potential keywords'. For a store, name the product, the material, the use case.
Keep sentences simple and declarative: one idea per sentence, clear subject-verb-object, and cut anything that takes two reads to parse.
Use this as a clarity checklist for shoppers and extracted excerpts; the source's positional-weight explanation is not a universal model behavior.
caveats: The source explicitly rejects writing a special 'AI format'; the audience remains human readers.
Word count is not a factor — see the length/freshness/format data card.
Google does not require special content chunking. Preserve context and qualifications even in concise answers.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Content length, freshness and format signals for AI citations
cards.summary: Cited pages are not long, are meaningfully fresher than organic results, and skew heavily toward lists and comparisons — so refresh and format beat word count.
cards.use_when: Deciding whether to rewrite or expand category and guide pages, and choosing which content formats to invest in for AI visibility.
steps: Do not lengthen articles for citation's sake: across 174,000+ cited pages the source reports a 0.04 correlation between word count and citation, and 53.4% of cited pages are under 1,000 words.
Prioritise freshness: cited content averaged 25.7% fresher than traditional organic results, and for ChatGPT 89.7% of top-cited pages were updated in 2025 with 76% refreshed in the last 30 days.
Make updates substantive, not cosmetic — do not simply change the publish date.

Choose formats AI can lift from: 43.8% of all cited pages are listicles (best X, top X), and data-driven content with original stats and X-versus-Y comparisons also performs because AI cites specific numbers and comparison pages map to how users ask questions.
Apply this to store content by maintaining best-of roundups, head-to-head comparisons and original benchmark or sizing data tied to your catalogue.
caveats: These are Ahrefs study figures presented in the course, not universal benchmarks; re-validate against your own pages over time.
Frequent 30-day refreshes describe ChatGPT's cited set, not a requirement for every page.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Refresh sleeper pages to win citations fastest
cards.summary: Find pages with backlinks but declining traffic and update them, because existing authority plus refreshed content is the quickest route to AI citations.
cards.use_when: Replenishment of an existing content library: choosing which product guides or category pages to update this quarter instead of writing new ones.
steps: Open a site explorer / top-pages report for your domain and sort by traffic change to find pages with significant declines.
Filter for pages that have both a decent number of backlinks (existing authority) and a clear traffic decline (likely stale content).
Verify the decline is a content problem, not a link problem: if the page never had many referring domains, a rewrite probably won't help.
Update the content meaningfully — new data, new products, changed specifications, current-year details — rather than editing the date.
Prioritise these before net-new content when you need fast AI visibility, since freshness is a strong citation signal.
caveats: Requires access to historical traffic and backlink data for the page.
Traffic decline can have causes other than staleness (lost rankings from algorithm changes, seasonality) — check before investing.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Brand the frameworks you invent to resist LLM flattening
cards.summary: Name original concepts after your brand and distribute them widely so AI credits rather than absorbs them as generic knowledge.
cards.use_when: Differentiating your store's expertise — sizing systems, fit guides, material standards or comparison frameworks — in a market where AI summarises everything.
steps: Identify an original concept worth owning, e.g. a scoring matrix or fit methodology.
Name it with your brand prefix rather than a generic label — the source's example contrasts 'content scoring matrix' with '<brand> content scoring matrix'.
Define the concept explicitly on your own site so the definition is citable.
Distribute it widely with the name attached: blog, social channels, podcasts, community platforms such as Reddit.
The rationale: the source notes LLMs tend to flatten unlabelled original concepts into general knowledge without credit; repetition with the name attached makes that harder.
caveats: Branded frameworks are the presenter's recommendation, not a measured causal result.
Requires consistent naming across channels to work.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Tier-one mentions: get listed on editorial listicles and comparison pages
cards.summary: Prioritise mentions in authoritative third-party editorial content, which correlate most strongly with AI overview visibility, and locate the target pages programmatically.
cards.use_when: Acquisition and brand-building for a store trying to be named in AI answers to best-of and versus queries in its product category.
steps: Understand why: the source reports branded web mentions had the strongest correlation with AI overview visibility across 75,000 brands (0.664), and mentions on highly linked pages correlated at 0.7 — higher than general brand mentions, backlinks or domain rating.

Open a cited-domains report for your brand to see which sites AI cites for your topics, plus response counts, page counts and mention frequency. Identify the equivalents of the source's examples (KBB for cars, CNET for tech, niche industry blogs) for your category.

Do not wait for a page to already be cited: use a content search tool with title:best or title:versus plus a minus operator on your brand name to surface listicles and comparison posts where you are absent, then filter for pages with many referring domains.
Pursue those pages for inclusion or review, since 43.8% of ChatGPT citations are listicles and comparisons.
Log which targets convert into mentions for later measurement.
caveats: Correlation, not causation — the source presents these as the strongest observed relationships.
Editorial inclusion usually cannot be bought directly; expect outreach effort.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Tier-two mentions on community and UGC platforms, without spamming
cards.summary: Reddit, Quora and niche forums are heavily cited and foundational training sources, but the source warns against dropping your brand name into threads.
cards.use_when: Community-led visibility for a store whose buyers research in forums and subreddits before purchasing.
steps: Recognise the value: the source states Reddit is one of the most frequently cited sources by ChatGPT and a foundational training source for LLMs; Reddit also appears among top AI-overview citations.
Identify the specific communities and threads where your category is discussed.
Do not spam threads with brand mentions — the source explicitly says that is not the play.
Contribute genuinely useful answers that establish expertise, so mentions are earned through participation rather than inserted.
Treat this as an ongoing presence channel rather than a one-off campaign, because community citations and training associations compound.
caveats: The source cuts off before detailing the full tier-two method, so this card covers the stated principle only.
Community platforms penalise promotional behaviour; expect slow returns.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Query fan-out and why topical coverage beats single-keyword pages
cards.summary: AI expands one prompt into many synthetic sub-queries, so pages must cover a whole topic rather than one exact match keyword.
cards.use_when: Category page and buying-guide planning for a store that wants to be pulled into AI answers about its product area.
steps: Understand the mechanic: search moved from one-query-one-result to many-to-one, and AI search is one-to-many — a single prompt fans out into sub-queries run in parallel and merged into one answer.

Assume breadth: the source cites research showing an average prompt triggers 9–11 fan-out queries, some as high as 28, and one ChatGPT deep-research example ran 420 searches for a red phone case query.

Audit for topic completeness. The source's example: a page on starting a podcast that covers only the basics but omits equipment, hosting and promotion loses the citation to a page that covers them. For a store, a category page should cover selection criteria, compatibility, sizing, use cases and comparisons.

Do not build a keyword list from fan-out queries: the source says they are synthetic, generated in the moment and inconsistent, and over 95% have zero search volume — use them as a window into what topics AI considers important, not as targets.
If your tooling exposes fan-out queries for prompts (the source uses Ahrefs Brand Radar's AI responses report), review them to sense topic expectations.
caveats: Fan-out counts are research findings, not fixed volumes; the same prompt can produce different fan-outs each time.
Tool support for viewing fan-out queries may change — verify current availability.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: AI visibility is probabilistic, not a ranking position
cards.summary: Citations vary between identical prompts and are shaped by consensus, freshness and authority, so track share of visibility rather than a fixed rank.
cards.use_when: Setting expectations and KPIs for a store's AI search programme before investing in content or mentions.
steps: Stop expecting a fixed position. The source describes AI output as probabilities stacked on probabilities: training patterns, retrieved-page signals and a temperature setting that adds randomness — asking the same question five times might cite you three times.
Track AI visibility as a distribution across repeated prompts and platforms rather than a single rank check.

Influence the probability levers the source identifies: consensus (multiple sources saying the same thing about your brand makes AI more likely to repeat it), freshness (cited content about 25% fresher than traditional SERPs), and authority (pages ranking well in traditional search have a head start).
Use this to justify investing in consistent third-party mentions and ongoing content refresh rather than one-off campaigns.
Report share of voice and impression/mention counts alongside any ranking-style metric.
caveats: The source's '25% fresher' and citation-overlap figures come from Ahrefs' own studies; treat them as source-specific heuristics.
Probabilistic measurement requires repeated sampling — single checks are unreliable.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Two information sources: training data vs real-time retrieval
cards.summary: AI answers come from static training snapshots or live web retrieval (RAG), giving you two distinct levers — broad mentions and crawlable, rankable content.
cards.use_when: Planning how a new product launch or store brand will be discovered in AI assistants within weeks rather than months.
steps: Models can answer from learned patterns, provided context or retrieved information. Training data and update schedules differ by model and are not controlled by publishing a store page.
Recognise real-time retrieval (RAG): when a question is fresh or specific, the assistant searches the web via APIs, pulls pages, reads them and generates an answer from what it found.
Prioritize accurate, retrievable product information and credible brand coverage. Broader mentions do not guarantee inclusion in future model training.
For a product launch, publish current crawlable facts and monitor retrieved answers; treat changes to non-search answers as uncertain observations.
Check that AI crawlers are not blocked — see the robots.txt card.
caveats: Training-data refresh cadence ('maybe every 6 months or so') is the presenter's approximation and varies by model and vendor.
Retrieved pages are scored alongside trained patterns, so retrieval does not guarantee a mention.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Check CDN and robots rules for accidental search-crawler blocking
cards.summary: Verify public product and collection pages are accessible to the intended search crawlers while preserving separate training choices.
cards.use_when: A store wants product pages discoverable in AI search or is diagnosing missing product visibility after CDN or theme changes.
steps: Inspect robots.txt and CDN or firewall rules for representative public product and collection URLs.
For ChatGPT search, check OAI-SearchBot; GPTBot controls training separately. For Google Search AI features, inspect Googlebot access. Do not blanket-enable unrelated crawlers.
Check HTTP responses and actual crawler logs where available; compare initial HTML with rendered product facts to identify rendering dependencies.
Correct unintended blocks for the desired search crawler, preserving deliberate training restrictions and protected checkout or account areas.
Retest after deployment and future CDN or theme changes; access enables retrieval but does not guarantee recommendation.
caveats: Verify current crawler documentation and CDN settings; defaults change. A spoofed user-agent test alone does not verify real crawler access.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Capture AI-driven demand with a post-purchase 'how did you hear about us?' survey
cards.summary: Unlinked AI mentions arrive as 'Direct' traffic, so self-reported attribution is needed to see the brand awareness AI generates.
cards.use_when: Attribution and retention analytics for a store whose AI mentions often come without links.
steps: Unlinked recommendations can lead to later direct visits, branded search or no visit. Referral analytics cannot measure all of this; source-reported link percentages are context, not a universal attribution rule.
Add a 'How did you hear about us?' question to the post-purchase survey so buyers can self-report AI assistants, brand searches or word of mouth.
Provide options that distinguish AI assistants, organic search, social, and a friend or colleague, plus an open text field.
Review responses periodically alongside AI mention data to judge whether AI awareness is translating into purchases.
Combine with platform-level mention and citation monitoring rather than relying on click-through alone.
caveats: Self-reported attribution is imprecise and subject to recall and selection bias.
Requires enough purchase volume for the responses to be meaningful; low-volume stores should treat it directionally.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Diagnose visibility gaps across six dimensions
cards.summary: A six-bucket framework — visibility, narrative, topic, format, web mentions and demand — turns AI visibility data into a prioritised action list.
cards.use_when: Quarterly planning for a store's content and brand programme, deciding whether to fix, build or influence.
steps: Map branded entities first: main brand, sub-brands, product names, proprietary features or metrics, and associated personal brands. Each has its own AI visibility profile and can be analysed separately.
Attach to each entity the topics and attributes it should be associated with, inferred from recurring adjectives and modifiers people use alongside your brand or category.
Run the audit and read four metrics per AI platform: mentions, citations (actual source links), impressions (estimated exposure), and AI share of voice versus competitors.

Classify each finding into the six gaps: visibility (you appear less than competitors), narrative (AI describes you against your intended positioning, e.g. 'budget alternative' when you are premium), topic (topics you should own but do not), format (content types AI cites that you do not produce, such as video), web mentions (external listicles, review sites, forums naming competitors but not you), and demand (branded queries or awareness opportunities you have not captured).

Prioritise by asking how much demand the opportunity could drive, whether it supports credibility, and whether it improves citation chances, then label each fix as fix (optimise existing), build (create new) or influence (offsite mentions).
Start with quick wins: a page that already ranks but needs an update to close a topic gap, or a major listicle your competitors are on that you can win via outreach.
Repeat the same audit for competitors to find topics and gaps you have overlooked.
caveats: The six-gap framework is attributed to an Ahrefs guide and the tooling shown is Ahrefs Brand Radar — the dimensions are transferable, the reports are product-specific.
Most stores will find gaps concentrated in one or two buckets, which the source frames as a signal to build systems around them.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Platform-specific citation preferences: where to allocate AEO effort
cards.summary: AI platforms barely overlap in sources, so match your existing strengths and target sources to the specific engine you prioritise.
cards.use_when: Channel prioritisation: choosing whether to invest in YouTube, editorial PR, community presence or traditional rankings based on which AI engine your category's buyers use.
steps: Accept divergence: across the top 50 cited domains on Google AI overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity, only seven appeared on all three (14% overlap), per the source.
For Google AI overviews: favour authoritative established sites and Google-owned properties; the source states YouTube accounts for about 5.6% of all AI overview citations and Reddit is also strong.

For ChatGPT: favour publishers and media; the source reports the median domain rating of its top cited pages is 90, and that licensing deals with outlets influence sourcing. Being mentioned on high-DR editorial sites, Reddit or niche review sites may matter more than your own pages' Google rank.

For Perplexity: it aligns most closely with traditional Google rankings — the source reports about 28.6% of its citations come from Google top-10 pages, versus roughly 8–10% overlap for ChatGPT — so if you already rank well in Google, Perplexity is likely your fastest AI visibility.

For Google AI mode: do not assume it mirrors AI overviews. The source reports only 13.7% citation overlap despite 86% semantic similarity in answers, YouTube as the top cited domain, and Quora cited 3.5x more than in AI overviews, with heavier Facebook and Instagram sourcing.

Prioritise by market share first (the source says Google AI features and ChatGPT hold most AI search traffic currently, with Perplexity much smaller), then by how much overlap exists with your existing SEO strengths.
Inspect which cited domains differ across platforms for your own brand before committing budget.
caveats: Platform sourcing mixes change frequently; these figures are source-specific snapshots.
The source also reports the AI-overview/top-10 Google connection weakening from 76% to about 38% in a more recent study, and that 14% of cited pages do not rank in Google's top 100 at all.
Do not build separate strategies per platform — the source recommends shared fundamentals with prioritised targeting.
cards.source_name: AI SEO Course for Beginners_ Complete AEO Tutorial.docx

cards.title: Treat AI visibility as a spectrum: cited, mentioned, or invisible
cards.summary: Three states of AI visibility, each with different business value, so define which state matters for your store before optimising.
cards.use_when: Goal-setting and reporting for an AI search programme, and choosing whether to chase links, mentions or both.
steps: Distinguish the three states: cited and linked (AI links to your page — best case for direct traffic, easiest to measure); mentioned but not linked (AI names you with no clickable link, functioning as word-of-mouth at scale that drives brand search); and fully invisible (you cannot fix what you cannot see).
Weigh reliance on links accordingly: the source reports about 28% of AI mentions include a link on average, with platform variation from 51.6% (Perplexity) to 10.7% (AI overviews).

Note that linked mentions concentrate on higher-traffic prompts: the source reports links appear in about 78% of Perplexity impressions despite 51% of mentions, and 71% of Gemini impressions despite 16.8% of mentions.
Track unlinked mentions as possible brand exposure; a mention is not automatically a training example or proof of a purchase contribution.

Match goal to business type: for product sellers, target being named when buyers ask about your category (e.g. a 'best golf balls' query where shoppers can click through to retailers or manufacturers); for publishers and creators, treat training-data visibility as the long game; for the invisible, start with the gap audit.
Measure the gap between impressions and mentions in your AI visibility tool — that gap is your opportunity.
caveats: Mention-to-link percentages and impression weightings are Ahrefs study figures, not universal constants.
Unlinked mention value is argued through training-association theory and a 0.664 correlation across 75,000 brands — correlation, not proof of causation.
